en.headline: Kai Tak Mall July sales rise more than 20% from opening levels
en.dek: The sports-park operator said continuous mega-events and progressive opening of leisure facilities lifted both footfall and spending at the retail halls.
body: Kai Tak Sports Park reported that sales at its retail mall in July rose more than 20 per cent compared with the levels recorded shortly after the park’s opening in March. Average daily footfall in the second quarter also increased by more than 10 per cent from the first quarter.

The operator attributed the gains to a steady stream of sports and entertainment events together with the gradual opening of outdoor facilities and the large family play area. Occupancy at the mall is approaching 90 per cent, with more than 70 food-and-beverage outlets, nearly 30 per cent of which extend hours into the early morning on event nights.
International brands continue to open stores at the complex. The operator expects further growth in the second half as additional major events and the National Games take place.

zh.headline: 啟德零售館7月銷售額較開幕初期升逾兩成
zh.dek: 體育園表示連場盛事及運動消閒設施陸續啟用帶動人流及生意，第二季日均人流較首季升逾一成。
body: 啟德體育園公布，旗下啟德零售館7月銷售額較3月開幕初期顯著增加超過兩成，第二季日均人流亦較首季上升逾一成。
園方指增長受惠於連場體育及娛樂盛事，加上戶外設施及大型親子遊樂空間逐步開放。零售館出租率接近九成，進駐逾70間食肆，當中近三成會在盛事期間延長營業至凌晨，配合夜經濟。
多個國際品牌相繼進駐。園方預料下半年隨更多大型活動及全國運動會舉行，人氣及生意將繼續向好。
